criteria.criterion: A stand-in claude reporting a newer patch than the pin (pin 2.1.299, binary 2.1.301) is accepted by check_pinned, and the returned version is 2.1.301. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`.
criteria.evidence: claude::stand_in_tests::a_newer_patch_is_accepted_and_the_reported_version_returned passed. It asserts check_pinned(2.1.301 stand-in, "2.1.299") == "2.1.301" and that an exact 2.1.299 stand-in is accepted too. All 49 tests passed (1 ignored helper).

criteria.criterion: Tests show a binary with an older patch than the pin, a different major or minor, or an unparseable or empty version is still refused, with an error naming both the found and pinned versions. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`.
criteria.evidence: accepts_follows_the_table (15 rows: older patch, other minor or major, empty, abc, 2.1, -beta suffix, four parts, +1) and refused_versions_are_named_with_the_pin_and_the_hint passed. The second test runs stand-ins reporting 2.1.298, 2.2.0, 3.1.299, an empty version, garbage and 2.1.301-beta, and asserts the Spawn message contains the quoted found version, 2.1.299 and 'needs no repin'.

criteria.criterion: ClaudeCodeDriver::new built with a pin and a binary of a different accepted patch records the binary's reported version, not the pin, and a test asserts this. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`.
criteria.evidence: a_driver_records_the_reported_version_not_the_pin passed: with_marker (which `new` calls directly) with a 2.1.301 stand-in and pin 2.1.299 gives info().version == "2.1.301". The wiring tests deferred_driver_reports_the_version_that_ran_after_it_is_built and deferred_driver_reports_the_pin_when_the_binary_cannot_report also passed.

criteria.criterion: xtask ensure_claude uses the same compatibility rule, so a newer-patch claude on PATH is used rather than triggering an npm install. A test covers the comparison. Run `cargo test -p xtask`.
criteria.evidence: Both tests passed: claude_compat_follows_the_table_on_the_first_token_of_the_output and claude_compat_picks_a_newer_patch_on_the_path_over_installing. Reading the diff, ensure_claude now calls pick_claude and falls back to npm only when pick_claude returns None.

criteria.criterion: `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` pass, and `cargo fmt --check` is clean.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded fmt and clippy runs passed, but its recorded test run FAILED (CI run 41710043053). I reproduced the failure: the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list panics with [Finding { condition: "a", reason: "hit not in the confirmed list: D03 amended by D154 (line 4222, in D154)" }]. This change caused it, through its D154 'amends D03' wording. The test reads docs/decisions.md and docs/decision-links.toml, which are tracked files in the snapshot, not records/.

criteria.criterion: docs/decisions.md gains an entry amending D03 that states the rule, the alternatives (any 2.x, auto-repin, keep exact), what is lost (an identical version on every run), and the reversal cost. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: D154 is appended after D153 and has Case, Root cause, Decision (the rule), Alternatives (a) any 2.x, (b) auto-repin, (c) keep exact match, Tradeoff (no single identical version per run), Reversal cost (Low) and Provenance. findings.evidence: The file was in the planned files list (criterion 3, finding 1), so DeferredDriver::info reports the version that ran. It is needed for the request and adds no unrelated scope.

summary: The change does what was asked: Athena now accepts a newer patch of the pinned Claude Code (same major.minor, patch at or above the pin) and records the version the binary reports. I ran the targeted tests in athena-agent, athena-cli (DeferredDriver) and xtask (claude_compat), and all pass. The candidate still fails, because it breaks the workspace test suite. The new D154 entry in docs/decisions.md says "amends D03". The backtest parser reads that as an amendment link, but the link was not added to the confirmed list in docs/decision-links.toml. As a result, `backtest the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list` fails in CI, and I reproduced the failure locally with the message "hit not in the confirmed list: D03 amended by D154 (line 4222, in D154)". Criterion 5 is therefore unmet. To fix it, either add a confirmed [[link]] for D03 amended by D154 at line 4222 to docs/decision-links.toml (that file is outside the deliverables list), or reword D154's heading and Decision line so the parser finds no unconfirmed link. Of these two, adding the link is the more honest fix.
